'''Chapter 1158''' is titled "Rocks vs. Harald".

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]], Vol. 40: "Here lies the pirate of justice"

The grave features the name {{Nihongo|"[[Kouzuki Moria]]"|光月もりあ|Kōzuki Moria}}.

==Short Summary==
After [[Silvers Rayleigh|Rayleigh]] received a letter from [[Shakuyaku]], the [[Roger Pirates]] decide to visit her at her [[Shakky's Rip-off Bar|bar]] on [[Hachinosu]]. While there, they met [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] and his [[Rocks Pirates|crew]], though the rules of the bar prevented any fighting. At [[Elbaph]], [[Harald]] and Rocks engage in a battle, but after it ends in a draw, their friendship comes apart and Rocks gives up on trying to recruit Harald. Since then, they would never meet again until the day of a certain incident. A year later at [[God Valley]], the twin brothers [[Shanks]] and [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]] are born.

==Long Summary==
[[Roger Pirates|Roger's]] crew inform him that [[Shakuyaku|Shakky]] has opened up her [[Shakky's Rip-off Bar|bar]] on [[Hachinosu]], so they can go and see her, but Roger seems to be in a bad mood. [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] asks [[Silvers Rayleigh|Rayleigh]] if it has to do with their previous conversation, but Rayleigh denies talking about anything. In reality, Rayleigh revealed to Roger that he was given a note by Shakky, which Roger says cannot be interpreted as anything other than a love letter from her, as it read "Come and get me". Roger is upset that Rayleigh is not planning on going to her as according to him, he has no interest in settling down, but he knew how Roger felt regarding Shakky which is why he did not show him it until then. Regardless, Roger declares he will not give up on her and they make their way to Hachinosu. Meanwhile, [[Figarland Garling|Garling]] explained to the [[Five Elders]] that while he was on a mission, he visited [[God Valley]], where he tried to convince the people to join the [[World Government]], only to be rejected. In addition to the island's vast resources that would benefit the [[World Noble|World Nobles]], Garling claimed he found something there that would please [[Imu]], and as such, Garling personally recommended they make God Valley the site of their next [[Native Hunting Competition]].

On Hachinosu, pirates from all over the world came to see Shakky at her bar, with her "abysmal service" enjoyed by everyone. One day, Shakky noticed that [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]] had a happy and fulfilled look on his face, except it was not aimed at her. [[Charlotte Linlin|Linlin]] teased that Rocks found a woman he genuinely loves (though Rocks tries to keep it a secret), and on top of that, [[Buckingham Stussy|Buckin]] suspected Rocks' happiness is stemming from becoming a father as well. Roger arrives along with the rest of the crew, but Rocks angrily reminds him that Hachinosu is his island, only for Roger to remind him that no one is allowed to fight in Shakky's bar. As the Roger Pirates start drinking, Shakky asks Roger where Rayleigh is, only to be told he stayed on the ship, to her displeasure. [[Gloriosa]], on the other hand, glomps Roger and begs him to take her on his ship, but Roger states he is not interested in women who throw themselves at someone (with the exception of Shakky, much to Gloriosa's annoyance). Shakky then passes out due to Rayleigh's absence, indicating she has [[Love Sickness]] as well and for him.

Sometime later on [[Elbaph]], [[Harald]] ended up accepting the Five Elders' terms, so when Rocks returned to recruit him, the two ended up fighting instead. Rocks became furious at Harald for caving into the World Government's demands, claiming they are only using him and his people for muscle and he is not seeing it. Harald, however, counters that even though the World Nobles are terrible, they have the power to help him usher Elbaph into the world and away from the violent history of the past, which he considers worth the risk. Unable to change his mind, Rocks declares that their friendship is over and he is done trying to recruit him, while Harald calls Rocks a villain destined for failure. Ultimately, neither one was able to kill the other, but the two would not meet again until the fateful incident. Despite Rocks no longer visiting Elbaph, [[Loki]] still tried to keep up to date on his actions, while starting to lessening his guard down around [[Ida]].

Thirty-nine years before the present day, the people of God Valley see that [[Magnolia|a woman]] has given birth to identical twins, and notice how they inherited her red hair. As they offer to help raise the kids, the woman introduces them as [[Shanks]] and [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*At sea, the [[Roger Pirates]] inform [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] that [[Shakuyaku]] is running her [[Shakky's Rip-off Bar|bar]] on [[Hachinosu]].
**Roger was in a sour mood after [[Silvers Rayleigh|Rayleigh]] revealed he received a letter from Shakuyaku after fighting the [[Kuja Pirates]].
**Being hopeful again, Roger decides to take his crew to Hachinosu in order try to take her.
*[[Figarland Garling|Garling]] speaks with the [[Five Elders]].
**Garling says he visited [[God Valley]] during an assignment, but could not reach an agreement for it to join the [[World Government]].
**Garling mentions he made a [[Davy Family|special discovery]] at God Valley that he believes will please the "[[Imu|Great One]]". Because of this, he suggests that the next [[Native Hunting Competition]] in two years be held at God Valley.
*While the [[Rocks Pirates]] are at Shakky's Bar, everyone realizes that Rocks fell out of love with Shakuyaku in favor of [[Eris|another woman]]. [[Buckingham Stussy|Miss Buckin]] believes his grin to imply he is expecting a [[Marshall D. Teach|child]].
*Later, the Roger Pirates meet the Rocks Pirates and Shakuyaku inside the bar.
**The Roger Pirates had defeated all of the pirates waiting in line so they could get inside.
**[[Gloriosa]] meets Roger again, but he refuses her request to join him.
**Shakuyaku wonders where Rayleigh is, then [[Love Sickness|passes out]] after realizing he stayed behind at the [[Oro Jackson]].
*At [[Elbaph]], [[Harald]] fights against Rocks to get Elbaph accepted into the [[World Government]].
**After the battle ends in a draw, Harald and Rocks end their friendship, and Rocks gives up on trying to recruit Harald.
**Since this battle, the two would never see each other again until a fateful incident.
*39 years ago at God Valley, [[Shanks]] and [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]] are born to a [[Magnolia|red-haired woman]]. The citizens help raise them instead of their absent father.
